---
title: "BiAA vs BiAA robusto"
format: html
jupyter: doctorat-mireia
---

Los mismos datos que en `03_biaa.qmd` con 15 celdas outlier. Hipótesis:
el BiAA estándar mete los outliers en los arquetipos; el robusto (Huber por
celdas) los descarta y recupera la Z original.

```{python}
import itertools
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from src.biaa import biaa
from src.robust_biaa import robust_biaa

np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True)
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n, m, k, c = 50, 40, 3, 3

Z_true = rng.uniform(0.1, 0.9, (k, c))
S0_true = np.vstack([np.eye(k), rng.dirichlet(np.ones(k), n - k)])
S1_true = np.vstack([np.eye(c), rng.dirichlet(np.ones(c), m - c)])
X = S0_true @ Z_true @ S1_true.T

rows, cols = rng.integers(0, n, 15), rng.integers(0, m, 15)
X[rows, cols] += 10  # 15 celdas outlier
```

## Ajustes

```{python}
*_, Z_biaa, _ = biaa(X, k, c)
*_, Z_rob, info_rob = robust_biaa(X, k, c)
```

## Arquetipos

Se alinean con `Z_true` antes de comparar (salen en cualquier orden).

```{python}
def align(Z, ref):
    perms = itertools.product(itertools.permutations(range(k)),
                              itertools.permutations(range(c)))
    return min((Z[np.ix_(p, q)] for p, q in perms),
               key=lambda Zp: np.abs(Zp - ref).mean())

Zs = {"Z real": Z_true, "Z BiAA": align(Z_biaa, Z_true), "Z BiAA robusto": align(Z_rob, Z_true)}
for name, Z in Zs.items():
    print(f"{name}  (error medio {np.abs(Z - Z_true).mean():.3f})\n{Z}\n")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.5))
vmax = max(Z.max() for Z in Zs.values())
for ax, (name, Z) in zip(axes, Zs.items()):
    im = ax.imshow(Z, cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=vmax)
    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(Z):
        ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center",
                color="white" if v > 0.6 * vmax else "#0b0b0b")
    ax.set(title=name, xticks=[], yticks=[])
fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes, shrink=0.8)
plt.show()
```

## Pesos del robusto

Un peso en [0, 1] por celda; ~0 es outlier. Las cruces marcan las celdas
contaminadas.

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
im = ax.imshow(info_rob["weights"], aspect="auto", cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=1)
ax.scatter(cols, rows, marker="x", s=40, color="#eb6834")
ax.set(xlabel="variables", ylabel="observaciones",
       title="Pesos efectivos por celda (× = celda outlier)")
fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
plt.show()
```
